content.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# fake-executor — a test-only worker for the v0.5 interruption harness
# (tests/interrupt.sh). Never shipped. It behaves like a delegated worker in
# one of several modes, journals every write it makes outside the plan with
# timestamps and its attempt ID, and prints its passdown.result/v1 payload
# as the last line of stdout, where the reference host extracts it.
#
#   fake-executor <mode>
#
# Environment (set by tests/harness/ref-host):
#   PASSDOWN_ATTEMPT  attempt ID (the host exports it into every worker)
#   FAKE_JOURNAL      append-only write journal, outside the fixture repo
#   FAKE_PLAN         plan path relative to the working directory
#   FAKE_TASK         task id
#   FAKE_TARGET       target repository (read-but-writes without confinement)
#   FAKE_HELPER       passdown-attempt (dispatch-external mode)
#   FAKE_DELAY        seconds to wait before the first write (default 0.3)
#   FAKE_DETACHED_DELAY  spawn-detached-writer: seconds before the late write
#   FAKE_DETACHED_AFTER  spawn-detached-writer: write only once this file exists
# Journals: FAKE_JOURNAL gets "<t1> <t2> <attempt> <location> <path>" per
# write; FAKE_JOURNAL.life gets "begin <pid> <t> <attempt> <location>" and
# "end <pid> <t>" per process.
# The working directory is the attempt location.
set -euo pipefail

mode="${1:?mode}"
attempt="${PASSDOWN_ATTEMPT:?PASSDOWN_ATTEMPT is not set}"
journal="${FAKE_JOURNAL:?FAKE_JOURNAL is not set}"
plan="${FAKE_PLAN:-docs/plan.md}"
task="${FAKE_TASK:-1.1}"
delay="${FAKE_DELAY:-0.3}"

now() { perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f\n", time'; }
